fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-e738d61c at 2e51e76c6: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/adapter/... passes; TestGuardReply denies Write (absolute and relative), Edit (absolute), MultiEdit (relative ../), NotebookEdit (relative notebook_path) under .rhiza/log/, and gives no reply for Write on /w/.rhiza/model.json, for Bash on a log path, for Read of a log path, and for PostToolUse. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/session-hook-log-guard passes: rhiza session hook PreToolUse with a Write on .rhiza/log/x/y.json prints permissionDecision deny naming rhiza apply; Write elsewhere, Bash and Read print nothing. The session-related internal/api tests (-run Session|Hook|Ask|Deliver|Interview) pass. The full internal/api run failed only its guard against the enclosing root's .rhiza-root/usage.live.json changing, which the live root daemon writes; this change does not touch usage. Diff read: session_run.go adds logEditReason (says write through rhiza apply, read with rhiza show, rhiza slice or cat) and sets the hook reply from Adapter.GuardReply; claudecode GuardReply checks only the four file tools' file_path/notebook_path, cleans and resolves the path against cwd, and parses no shell commands.
